title: Data center marketplace power and purchase screening examples
scope: Six selected public marketed examples chosen to illustrate power delivery stages and transaction filters. The review records what each source reports and does not estimate the prevalence of differences across any marketplace.

records.offer_as_published: Marketed for sale; confirm current status
records.phase_detail: Seller reports 18 MW in service and billed. Additional capacity is reported for 2028.
records.buy_now_screen: Potential lead. Verify uncommitted MW at the meter, assignability and current availability before underwriting delivery.

records.phase_detail: 3 MW reported live. The 20+ MW figure comes from a verbal prescreen. The listing says a formal study has yet to be commissioned.
records.buy_now_screen: Below 10 MW of reported existing service. Request a formal utility study for the expansion.

records.offer_as_published: Marketed for sale, long-term lease or colocation
records.phase_detail: 3 MW reported live. The 15 MW figure depends on a 44 kV transformer build-out.
records.buy_now_screen: Below 10 MW of reported existing service. Confirm current tenant commitments and transformer delivery before counting the expansion.

records.phase_detail: 6 MW reported committed, with building step-down due in Q1 2027. About 20 MW more depends on a second substation, with 2028 the earliest stated timing.
records.buy_now_screen: For lease only. Keep separate from purchase results and verify the first phase for a lease review.

records.phase_detail: 5 MW total utility and about 3.6 MW critical IT reported, based on a historical 1.4 PUE. The longer expansion would bring utility service to about 18.5 MW.
records.buy_now_screen: Pending and below 10 MW of reported existing utility service.

records.offer_as_published: Marketed as a sale of the site-holding entity
records.phase_detail: 100 MW feed line described as ready, with delivery expected in 2027 subject to signing a utility contract. The next 100 MW is in study.
records.buy_now_screen: Development lead. Request the signed utility contract, the first delivery schedule and the remaining work at the point of service.

evidence_boundary: As-marketed facts, not an independent utility service or deal-status verification. Null values mean the review did not establish that field from the published listing.
